2014_spells.sword-burst.description: You create a momentary circle of spectral blades that sweep around you. All other creatures within range must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 force damage.
2014_spells.sword-burst.effectSummary: Deal 1d6 force damage to a target within Self (5-foot radius)
2014_spells.sword-burst.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you create a momentary circle of spectral blades that sweep around you. All other creatures within range must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw; roll a d20, add the DEX modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC or take 1d6 force damage; The spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6). The effect happens immediately and then ends.
